title: Cost every bottle, price for profit, win repeat buyers
course_title: Detergent and Cleaning Products Production: Liquid Soap, Hand Wash and Safe Cleaning

say: Cost every bottle, price for profit, and win repeat buyers.
This is the video for module four of Detergent and Cleaning Products Production.

Many sellers know the price of sulphonic acid, but never add up bottles, labels, transport and their own time. They feel busy, but cannot find the profit. Cost has four groups. First, raw materials, at the price you actually paid.

panel.heading: Busy, but where is the profit?
items: Raw materials, at the price you paid
Your labour, so you can pay a helper later

say: Second, packaging: bottles or kegs, caps, labels and cartons.

panel.heading: Busy, but where is the profit?
items: Raw materials, at the price you paid
Your labour, so you can pay a helper later

say: Third, overheads: transport, pH strips, PPE wear and phone data.

panel.heading: Busy, but where is the profit?
items: Raw materials, at the price you paid
Your labour, so you can pay a helper later

say: Fourth, your labour. If you do not count it, you can never afford to pay a helper.

panel.heading: Busy, but where is the profit?
items: Raw materials, at the price you paid
Your labour, so you can pay a helper later

say: For example, Grace in Ibadan makes 25 litres of liquid soap. These prices are approximate, so use your own receipts.
All the chemicals, perfume, colour and preservative cost 21,000 naira.
Bottles with caps at 250 naira each, and labels at 60 naira, come to 7,750 naira.
Overheads for the batch are 3,000 naira.
Her labour is 4 hours at 1,000 naira an hour, so 4,000 naira.
The full batch costs 35,750 naira. Divided by 25 bottles, each bottle costs her about 1,430 naira. Any price below that loses money, however much she sells.
Now price from cost, not from what the next seller charges. Grace's bottle costs 1,430 naira.

panel.heading: Price with a clear margin
items: Compare with prices in your area

say: She wants a 30% margin, so she divides the cost by 0.70.

panel.heading: Price with a clear margin
items: Compare with prices in your area

say: That is about 2,043 naira, so she might price at 2,000 to 2,100.

panel.heading: Price with a clear margin
items: Compare with prices in your area

say: Then compare with local prices. If similar quality sells for much less, save on packaging or buying, not on the surfactant that does the cleaning.

panel.heading: Price with a clear margin
items: Compare with prices in your area

say: Chemical prices change quickly, so recalculate with every new stock. If cost rises, raise the price, change the pack size and tell customers, or accept a smaller margin for a while. Secretly diluting is not an honest choice.

panel.heading: Price with a clear margin
items: Compare with prices in your area
panel.rule: Never dilute the product and keep the same label

say: Drums, a scale, PPE and a first stock of bottles are a one-time start-up cost. For example, Grace spent 45,000 naira.

panel.heading: When is your start-up paid back?
items: After that, the profit is truly yours

say: She makes about 600 naira profit on each bottle.

panel.heading: When is your start-up paid back?
items: After that, the profit is truly yours

say: So 45,000 divided by 600 is 75 bottles to recover her start-up money.

panel.heading: When is your start-up paid back?
items: After that, the profit is truly yours

say: After that, the profit is truly hers. This number gives her a realistic sales target.

say: Your real goal is repeat customers. The strongest sales tool is a demo. Bring two plates with palm oil grease, two bowls and a measuring spoon.

panel.heading: The side-by-side grease demo
items: Two greasy plates, two bowls, a spoon
One spoon of your product per bowl
Same strokes; the buyer feels both plates
Show your label and batch number
Offer a trial size; agree a delivery day

say: Measure one spoon of your product into a bowl of water. Ask the buyer to use her current product in the other bowl.

panel.rule: Specific, tested benefits. No germ or medical claims.

say: Confirm the money has actually arrived in your account before you release goods. Fake transfer screenshots are a common scam.
Carry kegs upright with caps tight. Refill only into a clean, correctly labelled container, and never into drink bottles. And keep customers' numbers and addresses private.

panel.heading: Protect yourself and your buyers
items: Confirm money in your own account

say: Your capstone is a portfolio. It holds your safety station, master formula, batch records, specification, honest label and cost sheet, plus feedback from at least two users.
Write an honest reflection, and a 90-day plan tied to real buyers and real cash. You need the capstone and at least 70% in the final quiz for your certificate.
Your practice: cost one batch and set retail and bulk prices, work out your break-even number, run one grease demo, and assemble your portfolio.
Now continue with the lessons below.
